title: The Little Fawn Who Wandered: Always Stay in Sight!

lines.text: Daisy the spotted fawn skipped through the spring meadow alongside her watchful mother!
lines.caps: Daisy the spotted fawn skipped through the spring meadow alongside her *WATCHFUL | *MOTHER!

lines.text: A sparkly turquoise butterfly fluttered past, dancing from daisy to bluebell flower!
lines.caps: A sparkly turquoise butterfly fluttered *PAST, | dancing from daisy to bluebell *FLOWER!

lines.text: Daisy chased the fluttery wings, leaping over logs and deeper into the unfamiliar woods!
lines.caps: Daisy chased the fluttery wings, leaping over logs and deeper into the *UNFAMILIAR | *WOODS!

lines.text: When the butterfly flew away, Daisy looked around—the trees were tall, dark, and strange!
lines.caps: When the butterfly flew away, Daisy looked around—the trees were tall, dark, *AND | *STRANGE!

lines.text: Mama! she cried, her little heart thumping like a drum! She couldn't see the herd!
lines.caps: Mama! she cried, her little heart thumping like a *DRUM! | She couldn't see the *HERD!

lines.text: Remembering safety rules, Daisy stopped moving, stayed by a big oak, and called out loud!
lines.caps: Remembering safety rules, Daisy stopped moving, stayed by a big oak, and *CALLED | out *LOUD!

lines.text: Mama Deer heard her voice, dashed through the thicket, and nuzzled her baby safe and warm!
lines.caps: Mama Deer heard her voice, dashed through the thicket, and nuzzled her baby *SAFE | and *WARM!

lines.text: Always hold hands in big crowds and stay where parents can clearly see your face!
lines.caps: Always hold hands in big crowds and stay where parents can clearly see your *SMILING | *FACE!

lines.text: Stay safe and smart—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
